{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows positive bias (e.g., >0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent true outcomes show mean reversion toward lower levels after a spike.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices when sentiment is neutral or negative (e.g., <0.00), especially if model has overcorrected upward.",
    "Apply lag correction: if true outcome is significantly lower than forecast 3-5 days prior, adjust current forecast downward by 3-7%.",
    "Avoid sharp upward spikes in forecast after a recent low; cap forecast growth at 5% above prior 7-day average if sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "If sentiment history includes a recent +0.50, reduce forecast by 10-15% to account for potential market overreaction.",
    "When true outcome is consistently below forecast for 3+ consecutive days, apply a downward bias correction of 5-10% to next forecast."
  ]
}
